subject: general
question: What is the importance of 22 July 1947?

options.text: Leaders' discussion for selection of national anthem

solution:
The correct answer is__** Present National flag adopted.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On **22 July 1947**, the Constituent Assembly of India adopted the **present National Flag of India**.
 
• The flag consists of three horizontal stripes: **saffron at the top, white in the middle, and green at the bottom, with a navy blue Ashoka Chakra in the center of the white band.**
 
• The Ashoka Chakra has **24 spokes **and **represents justice, progress, and dharma (righteousness).**
 
• The flag became** the official flag **of independent India after **15 August 1947**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Symbolism of Colors**:

 
 
• **Saffron**: Symbolizes courage, sacrifice, and the spirit of renunciation.
 
• **White**: Represents peace, truth, and purity.
 
• **Green**: Stands for faith, fertility, and the growth of the land.
 
 
 
• **Ashoka Chakra**: The navy blue wheel in the center is derived from the Lion Capital of Ashoka and symbolizes the eternal wheel of law (dharma). It also reflects progress and righteousness.
 
• **Historical Background**: The design of the current national flag is based on the Swaraj Flag, which was the flag of the Indian National Congress and was first designed by Pingali Venkayya in 1921.
 
• **Legal Provisions**: The display and use of the National Flag are governed by the Flag Code of India, which lays down rules regarding its correct usage and respectful handling.
